title: Fast Rational Univariate Representation via Gaussian Elimination
summary: In this note, we present RationalUnivariateRepresentation$.$jl (https://newrur.gitlabpages.inria.fr/RationalUnivariateRepresentation.jl/), a Julia package for computing rational univariate representations of zero-dimensional polynomial systems. The package uses dense linear algebra and Gaussian elimination for the FGLM-like stage. The purpose of this contribution is to advocate for this choice and explain the implementation details that turn the algorithm into practical software.
